text:
incidentbot: Automatic PagerDuty page fired for service=INFERENCE-GATEWAY (5xx error-rate spike). Alert: INC-20260317-01. Threshold: 5xx > 3% over 2m. Auto-escalation in 5m if unacked. PD link: <https://pagerduty.company/INC-20260317-01>

morgan: acked on PD, taking first responder. I'm oncall for the next 25m.

sre-alex: I'm with you, taking lead for mitigation. Quick check: grafana shows /v1/generate 5xx concentrated from eu-west1, sudden ramp ~2:04pm UTC. Any recent deploys?

eng-lee: yes, canary of model-runtime v2 at 2:00pm (10% traffic). Rolling update to test kv-cache improvements.

morgan: FYI runbook -> https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/inference-5xx (step 1: isolate canary, step 2: check kvcache).

sre-alex: checking kvcache metrics: evictions spiked. snippet from metrics: `kvcache.evictions{region="eu-west1"} = 1200/s` and `kvcache.hit_rate = 0.42`

eng-lee: ok that matches a bug we saw in v2 where cache keys are slightly different under short prompts. I'll start rollback of canary to 0%.

sre-alex: meanwhile I'm going to temporarily rate-limit canary traffic at the LB layer to reduce errors: `curl -X PATCH https://lb-api/services/inference-gateway -d '{"routes": [{"path":"/v1/generate","rate_limit":200}]}'`

incidentbot: PagerDuty note: INC-20260317-01 acknowledged by morgan at 9900112240.

morgan: Eng Lee, please post rollback command when ready so I can watch error-rate.

eng-lee: issuing rollback now: `kubectl -n inference set image deploy/model-runtime model-runtime=redwood/model-runtime:stable-20260228 --record`

eng-lee: rolling back canary to stable. K8s rollout started (replicaset scaling).

sre-alex: traffic-shift started. Observability: 5xx trending down from 3.8% -> 1.2% within 45s.

morgan: checking customer impact: no large CS tickets yet, some internal traces show retries and increased latency for a small subset. Sam-cs, can you pre-prepare a short PSAT if customers call?

sam-cs: copied. I'll draft a quick note for CS with the rollback update and that we are monitoring.

sre-alex: also disabled the canary feature flag in routing so new sessions won't hit v2. Patch: `POST /config/route-override {"canary":false}`

eng-lee: confirmed canary disabled. kvcache hit rate climbing back to 0.89. No new evictions spike.

incidentbot: PagerDuty update: INC-20260317-01 status changed to "stabilized" (auto-update).

morgan: good to see 5xx under 1%. I'll keep monitoring for 20 more minutes then hand off to night oncall. Creating incident note and linking runbook + timeline.

sre-alex: added a postmortem checklist item to validate kv-cache key normalization in v2 and a regression test for short prompts.

oncall-rotation: I'll take the 20m watch after Morgan. Please leave notes on PD and #oncall-handoff.

morgan: will do. Final action: created PD incident with notes and linked runbook https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/inference-5xx and the rollback commands.

morgan: thanks all — keeping this thread for runbook notes. If anything regresses ping me directly. :thumbsup:
